A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LightMem. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable matching across additions, relocations, and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original LongMemEval-S experiments, baseline comparisons, component ablations, parameter sweeps, and category-wise results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds LoCoMo accuracy and efficiency results with GPT and Qwen backbones.

M1.justification: The compression, hybrid topic segmentation, topic-aware STM, timestamp-constrained update queues, and offline parallel updating procedures remain unchanged. Iterative compression, discussed in the new complexity analysis, was already documented in v1 Appendix B.1.

E1.justification: v2 adds LoCoMo evaluation alongside LongMemEval-S. Its approximately 300-turn, 9K-token conversations and single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, and open-domain questions substantially extend the evaluated conversational data and task coverage.

E2.justification: The original LongMemEval comparator set is unchanged. The new LoCoMo comparison separately evaluates MemoryOS(locomo), described as a simplified reproduction script, alongside MemoryOS(regular). This adds a comparator variant beyond extending the existing baseline families to another benchmark.

E3.justification: The added LoCoMo experiments introduce GPT configurations with STM threshold 768 and compression ratios 0.7 and 0.8. The retained LongMemEval split, incremental feeding, backbone models, judging prompts, and treatment of five failed samples remain unchanged. Newly stated retrieval controls document settings rather than establish a protocol revision.

E4.justification: Compression sensitivity, segmentation comparisons and ablations, STM threshold sweeps, category breakdowns, attention examples, and the memory-update case remain unchanged. v1 Figures 4–6 become v2 Figures 3–5; relocating the parameter tables does not add analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without documented repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Category sample counts and the existing discussion of small-category variability are retained.

E6.justification: v2 Table 3 adds LoCoMo results, including best reported LightMem accuracies of 72.99% for GPT and 72.60% for Qwen; Qwen FullText scores 74.87%. Existing LongMemEval and ablation table values are unchanged. The text also revises derived efficiency ranges, including Qwen combined token savings from 29–117× to 6.9–21.8×.

T1.justification: New Section 4 and Appendix A.2 introduce an analytical cost model with token-budget formulas, summarization-call counts proportional to N r^x T / th, update-trigger fractions, and a runtime-complexity comparison. v1 contains the method equations but lacks this mathematical analysis.

C1.justification: The three-stage lightweight-memory contribution remains intact. The abstract and introduction revise headline claims to include LoCoMo and distinguish combined costs from online-only costs. Reported abstract accuracy gains change from up to 10.9% on LongMemEval to 7.7%/29.3% across the two benchmarks.

C2.justification: v2 interprets the two-benchmark results as evidence of generalizability across scenarios and explains its construction-cost focus through shared retrieval and QA controls. Existing compression/STM tradeoffs, soft-update explanations, and ethical limitations are retained.

D1.justification: v2 identifies all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, specifies cosine retrieval and shared retrieval controls, and explicitly includes compression latency in runtime accounting. Its abstract replaces the linked statement that code is available with a future-release promise; actual external availability cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The reference lists match, and the related-work discussion retains the same positioning against prompt compression, RAG chunking, and agent-memory research. LoCoMo was already cited in v1.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites affect the abstract, preliminary pipeline description, metrics, and results narrative. v2 inserts a complexity section and background appendix and condenses the conclusion and future-work discussion. Most method, analysis, and related-work prose remains intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds substantial displays for complexity, LoCoMo results, workflow comparison, model mapping, and notation in Tables 1 and 3–6. It removes v1's human-memory schematic and moves the representative parameter table into the appendix as Table 8. The retained architecture and analysis figures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: LoCoMo evaluation and explicit embedding/retrieval details strengthen validation and reproducibility. Revised combined-cost reporting also corrects v1's inflated Qwen post-update efficiency summary. The overall gain is limited by continuing blanket outperformance claims that conflict with some table rows, and by the new complexity table counting summarization calls while omitting the update calls derived in the accompanying text.
